svg.text: Contiguous memory. O(1) access by index, O(n) insert in the middle.
Each node points to the next. O(1) insert at head, O(n) lookup.
Last in, first out. Push and pop are O(1).
First in, first out. Print queues, task queues, BFS.
Key goes through a hash function to a bucket. O(1) average lookup.
Left < node < right. O(log n) search when balanced.
